name: BanTH: Multi-label Hate Speech Detection Dataset for Transliterated Bangla
description: BanTH is a multi-label hate speech detection dataset for transliterated Bangla (Banglish) comprising 37,300 comments collected from 26 YouTube channels across News, Blogs, and Entertainment. It includes binary hate detection and multi-label categorization across 7 target groups: Political, Religious, Gender, Personal Offense, Abusive/Violence, Origin, and Body Shaming.
